newsitem.title: USA: Boxing-Bloodied Phillips stops Tszyu to take IBF jr welter title.
newsitem.headline: Boxing-Bloodied Phillips stops Tszyu to take IBF jr welter title.

text.p: Vince Phillips, bleeding from his mouth, ear and eye, stunned Russian-born Australian Kostya Tszyu with a 10th-round flurry to win the International Boxing Federation junior welterweight title on Saturday.
The end came at 1:22 of the 10th after Phillips pinned Tszyu into a corner and then pummelled him with a barrage of unanswered punches before the referee called a halt to the scheduled 12-rounder.
"Thank God I'm the champion," said an elated Phillips after the action-packed fight. "I've been looking forward to this for a long time."
"I lost and it was my mistake," declared Tszyu. "I didn't fight well."
Phillips, who had gone just 2-2 in his last four bouts, including a knockout loss to Ike Quartey in a battle for the IBF welterweight crown, came out with fire in his eyes.
But by the end of the third round, Tszyu was in control, peppering Phillips with jabs to the head and body. Midway through the third, Phillips was given a second warning for hitting below the belt.
Just as quickly as Tszyu had taken control, however, Phillips was right back in the fight, scoring repeatedly with solid shots over the next few rounds despite a puffy right eye and a bloody mouth.
In the seventh round, the Las Vegan caught Tszyu with a lightning fast left-right combination and down went the champion.

In the ninth round, both fighters landed huge shots and after one particular intense exchange, Phillips had a steady flow of blood coming from a cut under his right eye, his mouth and from behind his ear. Tszyu had blood oozing from a cut over his left eye.
"I didn't feel desperate after the cut," said Phillips. "My corner told me to keep my distance and I did."
The victory raised the 33-year-old Phillips's record to 36-3 with 25 knockouts. Tszyu, 27, dropped to 35-4.
Tszyu, who knocked out Jake Rodriguez on January 28, 1995, to win the crown, had defended it successfully five times.
